request: Match the bottom inset of mobile homepage icon cards to the top inset.
cause: The horizontal grid stretched every card to the tallest title among all catalogue cards.
changes: Mobile cards use their natural height.
The mobile track follows the active card height, with padding and native scrollbar space accounted for.
ResizeObserver watches cards so font loading and text wrapping are remeasured.

verification.regression: Observed failing test before implementation; focused test passed after implementation.

browser.keyboard_short_to_long: Tab navigation preserved; scrollTop 0; focused card not clipped
browser.desktop_1280: Equal-height cards preserved; no page horizontal overflow

verification.review: Independent review found no confirmed blocking issues; requested keyboard check completed successfully.

publication: Not deployed. No production site or advertising settings changed.
